description: In today's competitive sports landscape, having visually striking banners is crucial for capturing the attention of fans and promoting events effectively. This project focuses on creating custom-designed banners tailored specifically for sports events and teams. The banners will be designed to highlight upcoming games, showcase team merchandise, and engage the audience with vibrant graphics and compelling messaging. Our design process will involve understanding the unique identity of the team or event, incorporating team colors, logos, and relevant imagery to ensure the banners resonate with the target audience. Each banner will be optimized for various online platforms, ensuring they are eye-catching and effective in driving engagement. The final deliverables will include multiple banner sizes suitable for social media, websites, and email marketing campaigns, all crafted to enhance visibility and promote the sporting events effectively.
deliverables: One revision round based on client feedback (work)
Final files in multiple formats (JPEG, PNG, and PSD) (document)
Design guidelines document for future use (document)
